summary: Audited all 180 keys. The translation is generally readable, but ingredient claims, allergen terminology, and several dish names need correction before publication. Key coverage, {n}, prices, quantities, dates, and times are preserved.

corrections.current: 河粉无限免费加
corrections.corrected: 无限加粉
corrections.reason: The current word order is awkward. This is concise, matches the source label, and standardizes noodle refills as 加粉.

corrections.current: 食用生的或未全熟的鸡蛋、肉类、禽类、海鲜或贝类可能增加食源性疾病的风险，尤其对患有某些疾病的人士。使用溏心蛋、水波蛋、单面煎蛋或双面嫩煎蛋制作的菜品，以及一分熟或三分熟的牛排，可能未完全煮熟。如有任何顾虑，请告知服务员。
corrections.corrected: 食用生的或未熟透的蛋类、肉类、禽类、海鲜、甲壳类或贝类，可能增加患食源性疾病的风险，患有某些疾病的人士尤其如此。含溏心蛋、水波蛋、单面煎蛋或双面嫩煎蛋的菜品，以及一分熟或三分熟的牛排，均可能未熟透。如有任何顾虑，请告知服务员。
corrections.reason: 鸡蛋 narrows 'eggs'; 贝类 alone does not fully convey 'shellfish.' Restore the warning's explicit scope and repair the incomplete 尤其对 clause.

corrections.current: 牛奶
corrections.corrected: 乳类
corrections.reason: 牛奶 restricts the allergen category to cow's milk. Use the broader category label required by the stated FDA taxonomy.

corrections.current: 鸡蛋
corrections.corrected: 蛋类
corrections.reason: 鸡蛋 restricts the allergen category to chicken eggs. 蛋类 preserves the category's scope.

corrections.current: 甲壳类/贝类
corrections.corrected: 甲壳类
corrections.reason: For the explicitly requested nine-FDA-allergen system, this category is crustacean shellfish. The English label also needs clarification to 'Crustacean shellfish'; see terminology notes.

corrections.current: 坚果
corrections.corrected: 树坚果
corrections.reason: 坚果 is broader than 'tree nuts' and can blur the distinction from the separately listed peanut category.

corrections.current: 细滑河粉配牛骨浓汤，佐以洋葱、葱花和香菜。堂食河粉可免费无限加粉。

corrections.reason: 水煮蛋 leaves doneness unspecified; the English explicitly says 'hard-boiled.' Preserve that distinction for an egg-containing dish.

corrections.current: 黑椒牛肉薯条

corrections.corrected: 粗切酥脆薯条拌以新鲜香草和蒜蓉，撒上帕玛森芝士。配香辣 aji verde 蒜香酱、番茄酱和辣味蛋黄酱。

terminologyNotes: Allergen labels: milk → 乳类; egg → 蛋类; tree nuts → 树坚果. FDA's current interpretation includes milk from other ruminants and eggs from other domestic birds, so cow-only and chicken-only category labels are too narrow. [FDA allergen guidance FAQ](https://www.fda.gov/food/food-allergensgluten-free-guidance-documents-regulatory-information/frequently-asked-questions-food-allergen-labeling-guidance-industry).

Source issue: the FDA category is crustacean shellfish, excluding molluscan shellfish. The proposed 甲壳类 label and shrimp declarations follow the brief's explicit FDA scope; corresponding English category references should say 'Crustacean shellfish.' The general raw-food warning retains the broader 甲壳类或贝类 wording. [FDA guidance, question B.9](https://www.fda.gov/media/117410/download?attachment=).
Aioli → 蒜香酱; mayonnaise → 蛋黄酱. Preserve aji verde exactly. This terminology does not claim that aioli is egg-free; the safety note retains 'usually' and server confirmation.
Retain consistent, recognizable menu terms: beef belly → 牛五花; filet mignon → 菲力牛柳; brisket → 牛腩; soft tofu → 嫩豆腐; fries → 薯条; parmesan → 帕玛森芝士.
Pho → 河粉; noodle refill → 加粉; drink refill → 续杯; dine-in → 堂食. Keep rice vermicelli 米粉, glass noodles 粉丝, and explicitly stated wheat noodles 小麦面条 distinct.
Shaken describes the cooking style, not black-pepper seasoning. Use 越式爆炒 for the beef and 爆香配料 for the pho add-on. Shallots → 红葱头; red onions → 红洋葱; white onions → 白洋葱; salted shrimp → 盐渍虾.
Pandan is standardized as 香兰叶, an established name for the culinary plant. [Chinese Academy of Sciences botanical reference](https://xtbg.cas.cn/2022/wzbc/ylxx_1/201208/t20120813_3626366.html).
